name: Ghana
about: Dry season Nov–Mar (including the dusty Harmattan winds Dec–Jan) is best for touring; the main rains fall Jun–Jul, with a shorter secondary rainy stretch in Sep–Oct.
overview: Cape Coast and Elmina's slave-trade forts, Kakum's rainforest canopy walkway, and a country of deep significance for the African diaspora.
costOverview: Ghana is affordable throughout, with the historic castle-fort entries and Kakum's canopy walkway as the main sightseeing costs.

costItems.label: Kakum National Park entry & canopy walkway

specialSeasons.text: The Harmattan brings dry, dusty winds from the Sahara — hazy skies but comfortable, low-humidity heat.
